WITH filtered_d2 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2001 AND d_moy = 8
)
SELECT s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM (d2.d_date - d1.d_date)) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM (d2.d_date - d1.d_date)) > 30 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM (d2.d_date - d1.d_date)) <= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM (d2.d_date - d1.d_date)) > 60 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM (d2.d_date - d1.d_date)) <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM (d2.d_date - d1.d_date)) > 90 AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM (d2.d_date - d1.d_date)) <= 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM (d2.d_date - d1.d_date)) > 120 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM store_sales
JOIN store_returns ON ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number AND ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk
JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
JOIN filtered_d2 d2 ON sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
WHERE ss_customer_sk = sr_customer_sk
GROUP BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
ORDER BY s_store_name, s_company_id, s_street_number, s_street_name, s_street_type, s_suite_number, s_city, s_county, s_state, s_zip
LIMIT 100
